texts.preamble: Yogender Mandal vs Municipal Corporation Of Delhi And Ors on 13 September, 2023 Author: Siddharth Mridul Bench: Siddharth Mridul $~S-13 In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi Judgment Delivered On: 1 W.P.(C) 9954/2023 & Cm Appl. 38353/2023 (interim relief) Yogender Mandal .. Versus Municipal Corporation Of Delhi And Ors .... Respondents Advocates who appeared in this case: For the Petitioner : Mr. Dipak Raj, Mr. Anjani Kumar Mish Kamlesh Kumar Mishra & Mr. Kailash K Advocates. For the Respondents : Mr. Chetanya Singh, Ms. Ria Sachthey Sharma, Advocates for Mcd. Mr. Laksh Khanna, Advocate for Delhi Arvind Kumar, P.S.: Kashmere Gate. Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Siddharth Mridul Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal Judgment
texts.arguments: III. Pass an order directing the respondents, their officials, their agents etc. be restrained from harassing the petitioners from peacefully vending at their vending site. IV. Pass an order directing the respondent MCD to correct the nomenclature in the column for Type of Vendor from "Food/Snack with Gas Cylinder/Fire" to "Stationary Street Vendor" (in view of the Section 6 of the Act) as detailed in the vending certificate issued to the petitioner. V. Pass an order for quashing and setting aside the terms of certificate of vending printed at the back side of the vending certificate to the extent which is not applicable to a stationery street vendor. VII. Pass any such directions or order that this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the above-mentioned case. 5. For the sake of completeness, the said terms and conditions attached to the Certificate of Vending, are reproduced herein below:- "1. Vendor shall not have any other permanent or long-term vending certificate.
